vulnerability.name: Redis Unauthenticated Replication Module Load RCE
vulnerability.author: Thomas Shaw
vulnerability.description: A Redis instance exposed on the network with no authentication and no bind restriction. An attacker abuses the master-replica replication protocol to make the target replicate a rogue master and load a malicious shared library module, giving unauthenticated remote code execution as the redis service account. The root cause is a configuration weakness (no requirepass, protected mode off, module loading enabled), not a code defect, so there is no CVE.
vulnerability.hint: A database with no password, listening to the world.
vulnerability.solution: Redis accepts commands with no authentication; its replication protocol can be abused to load an attacker-supplied module and run commands.
